tagline: A bookshop for people who still browse.
audience: readers, book-club members, gift buyers and neighbours who want an independent bookshop with a reading café, a calendar of events and booksellers who actually read
voice: wry, warm and bookish. Short sentences, specific details, a little self-mockery, never twee and never shouty.
designNotes: Editorial design language recoloured to parchment backgrounds with deep forest-green text and a mustard accent, Libre Baskerville headings and Karla body, underlined link-style buttons.
brandFacts: Folio & Fable, 21 Candlemaker Row, Edinburgh EH1 2QA. Phone 0131 555 0118. hello@foliofable.co.uk. Sample copy: names, prices and reviews are examples to replace.
packTitle: Folio & Fable: Independent Bookshop Theme (6 Pages)
description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for an independent bookshop, library, café, publisher or literary festival, ready to make your own. Home, The Shop, Events, The Café, About and Contact share one warm, bookish identity: parchment backgrounds, deep forest-green type, a mustard accent, Libre Baskerville headings and underlined link buttons. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A split-image hero, four icon blurbs, a staff-picks grid, a full-bleed reader quote, a newsletter form, a floor-by-floor accordion, a gallery of corners, an events timeline, two book-club plans, member quotes, a café menu zigzag, a founder note and a contact page with a form are all in place. Names, prices and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
